Town Clerk
Town Clerk
The Town Clerk is the official record keeper for the Town of Wakefield. Records kept by the office include, but are not limited to,
vital statistics
like birth, marriage and death certificates; business certificates; and decisions of the Zoning Board of Appeals and the Planning Board. The Town Clerk is the keeper of the Town Seal.
